amendment.reason: Independent audit identified four previously omitted additive metrics.

checks.name: dataset_manifest_and_source_identity
checks.requirement: Verify run identity, contracts, source hashes, schema fingerprints and immutable input roots.

checks.name: partition_domain_equality
checks.requirement: Verify the exact same 211 year/month partitions.

checks.name: h2_foreign_key_to_g2
checks.requirement: Every H2 (data, famiglia) key must exist once in G2.

checks.name: shared_context_replication
checks.requirement: For every H2 row, inherited G2 family-day context must equal the matching G2 row using null-safe and type-aware comparisons.

checks.name: priceband_key_domain
checks.requirement: H2 keys must be unique, sorted and contain only valid family-priceband activity-catalog pairs.

checks.name: commercial_metric_reconciliation
checks.requirement: Aggregate approved priceband sales metrics by (data, famiglia) and reconcile them against the corresponding G2 family-level metrics with explicit exact or tolerance rules per metric.

checks.name: zero_and_observed_semantics
checks.requirement: Validate dense zero-fill, observed flags and active window semantics between family and priceband grains.

checks.name: cross_dataset_coverage
checks.requirement: Report temporal coverage, family coverage, pair coverage and all orphan or uncovered domains.

checks.name: unified_feature_lake_manifest
checks.requirement: Produce one immutable manifest linking G2 and H2 runs, contracts, schemas, row counts, partitions, lineage and validation receipts.

checks.name: resource_and_failure_envelope
checks.requirement: Record batch size, peak RSS, elapsed time, disk reads and fail without modifying either dataset.
